sources.snippet: 🔤 Fine-Tuning Qwen2-VL for Arabic OCR A complete, production-ready pipeline for fine-tuning Qwen2-VL on Arabic OCR tasks using LoRA/QLoRA This repository provides an end-to-end solution for training a state-of-the-art Arabic OCR model using the powerful Qwen2-VL vision-language model.

sources.title: Fine-Tuning Qwen2-VL for Arabic OCR - GitHub
sources.snippet: A complete, production-ready pipeline for fine-tuning Qwen2-VL on Arabic OCR tasks using LoRA/QLoRA This repository provides an end-to-end solution for training a state-of-the-art Arabic OCR model using the powerful Qwen2-VL vision-language model. The project is designed to be accessible, reproducible, and easy to extend, with a focus on achieving high accuracy on scanned Arabic documents.
